verdict.rationale: Unit's own materials show it is not itself a bank. It works through 'bank partners', holds deposit and wallet accounts in FBO structures, and connects to the Federal Reserve on behalf of partner banks, which places it as a direct platform layer over sponsor banks. The evidence never names a partner bank and says nothing about what happens to customer funds if Unit fails. Missing for 10: named charter-holding partner bank(s), explicit disclosure of the charter and sponsor relationship, platform-failure and customer-fund protection details (e.g. FBO ledger reconciliation, pass-through insurance), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I know exactly who holds the charter — whether the platform is a bank, a direct program with a named partner bank, or middleware between me and someone else's sponsor — and what happens to my customers if the platform fails

citations.quote: Companies can work with one or multiple Unit bank partners through the same infrastructure.
Unit is a registered Federal Reserve service provider with direct connectivity to Federal Reserve systems on behalf of partner banks.
Create deposit accounts and wallet accounts held in FBO structures.
